name: Petilil
flavour_text: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant
flavour_text: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Decidueye
flavour_text: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can’t afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

name: Pheromosa
flavour_text: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Kartana
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Blacephalon
flavour_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Mantine
flavour_text: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: It won’t attack while it’s alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Sharpedo
flavour_text: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

name: Shinx
flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavour_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

name: Blitzle
flavour_text: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
flavour_text: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Xurkitree
flavour_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Zeraora
flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Phantump
flavour_text: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavour_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
flavour_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Meditite
flavour_text: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

name: Medicham
flavour_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.

name: Baltoy
flavour_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavour_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Passimian
flavour_text: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won’t obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Palossand
flavour_text: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

name: Alolan Persian
flavour_text: The round face of Alolan Persian is considered to be a symbol of prosperity in the Alola region, so these Pokémon are very well cared for.

name: Sandile
flavour_text: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavour_text: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavour_text: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Nihilego
flavour_text: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.

name: Poipole
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
flavour_text: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Alolan Diglett
flavour_text: The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon’s habitat caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.

name: Aron
flavour_text: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavour_text: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Aggron
flavour_text: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Ferroseed
flavour_text: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

name: Ferrothorn
flavour_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Stakataka
flavour_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Lillipup
flavour_text: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

name: Herdier
flavour_text: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there’s a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

name: Stoutland
flavour_text: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Bewear
flavour_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Oranguru
flavour_text: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Celesteela
flavour_text: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Rowlet
flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Pheromosa
flavour_text: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

name: Blacephalon
flavour_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Alolan Meowth
flavour_text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

name: Celesteela
flavour_text: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
flavour_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
flavour_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Jynx
flavour_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavour_text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavour_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Aerodactyl
flavour_text: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

name: Nihilego
flavour_text: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
